annotations.title: Search inside what Yank has read

description: Full-text search inside the whole transcripts of every podcast and video yank.info has yanked, not only their five lines (§10.424). Returns moments: the source, where in it (startSeconds, endSeconds), the words around the match (snippet, the match between « and »), a moment link that opens the source at that second, and yankThisPartUrl, which yanks the few minutes around it. The words are a machine transcript (representation: transcript), not a checked line: to quote one, yank that part or use check_quote. Supports quoted phrases and a leading minus.

query.description: Words, a name, or a quoted phrase, as it might have been said.
